dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'C' and 'O' shaped light contours with sharp, serrated gradients between dark exterior fur and bright silvery-white interior. Four prominent rings on the mid-lateral flank show asymmetrical diameters with high-contrast boundary transitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of localized white pixel clusters concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge where light reflection is highest; clusters are smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior flipper region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest 'O' rings on the lateral mid-section form an obtuse triangle with a long axis following the longitudinal plane of the body.
